mapper.sql: a.user_account_id, a.member_key, a.username, a.fullname, a.email, m.role_id, r.role_name, m.team_id, NULL::varchar AS team_name, a.is_active, NULL::timestamptz AS last_login_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at

where.if: AND ( LOWER(a.username) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(a.fullname) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(a.email, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(m.pseudonym) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM tbl_auth_user_account a JOIN tbl_dim_member_pseudonym m ON m.member_key = a.member_key LEFT JOIN tbl_dim_role r ON r.role_id = m.role_id
ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC, a.username ASC OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_auth_user_account a JOIN tbl_dim_member_pseudonym m ON m.member_key = a.member_key LEFT JOIN tbl_dim_role r ON r.role_id = m.role_id
SELECT FROM tbl_auth_user_account a JOIN tbl_dim_member_pseudonym m ON m.member_key = a.member_key LEFT JOIN tbl_dim_role r ON r.role_id = m.role_id WHERE a.user_account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT role_id, role_name FROM tbl_dim_role ORDER BY role_name ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_auth_user_account a JOIN tbl_dim_member_pseudonym m ON m.member_key = a.member_key JOIN tbl_dim_role r ON r.role_id = m.role_id WHERE a.is_active = TRUE AND UPPER(r.role_name) = 'ADMIN' AND a.user_account_id <> #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_dim_member_pseudonym ( member_key, role_id, team_id, pseudonym, active_from, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberKey}, #{roleId}, NULL, #{pseudonym}, CURRENT_DATE, #{actor}, #{actor}, #{now}, #{now} )

INSERT INTO tbl_auth_user_account ( user_account_id, member_key, username, fullname, email, email_hash, password_hash, password_algo, is_active, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{memberKey}, #{username}, #{fullname}, #{email}, NULL, #{passwordHash}, #{passwordAlgo}, #{active}, #{actor}, #{actor}, #{now}, #{now} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_auth_user_account SET fullname = #{fullname}, email = #{email}, is_active = #{active}, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE user_account_id = #{accountId}
